High Officer '''Osmark Dryrock'''<ref>[[Dossier: Isiden Perenolde]]</ref> is a [[human]] located in the [[Dryrock Pit]] in [[Gilneas]]. He is the overseer of the prison compound and a well-respected Greymane royalist officer. As a token of honor, he was given the [[Signet of Silverlaine]], which had been seized during a siege on [[Ravenshire]] along with other possessions belonging to [[Baron Caliban Silverlaine]] and [[House Silverlaine]].

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Signet of Silverlaine]] for {{questlong|Alliance|45|Signet of Silverlaine (quest)|Signet of Silverlaine}}.
